hints: Brazil has no national urban cadastre; SICAR (rural, self-declared) is national but not the legal cadastre. Look for the STATE geoportal / IDE (e.g. IDE-SP, IEDE-RS, GeoSC, IDE-MG, IDE-PE, GeoPortal ES) and, if no state urban-lot layer exists, the capital city's 'lotes' layer (many prefeituras publish GeoServer WFS or ArcGIS: São Paulo lotes fiscais verified; Rio 'Lotes' verified; Recife verified; Curitiba verified; Fortaleza partial; Belo Horizonte blocked by WAF; Salvador negative). Many .gov.br hosts return 403 to bare requests: use browser headers and Referer. Record whether the layer is urban lots (IPTU) or rural (SICAR/INCRA SIGEF).
